visuals.heading: Objective Vs Summary

items.text: A career objective states what you are looking for, appropriate when you have limited or no work experience, since there is little prior track record to summarise instead.
It works best for freshers, students, and people making a significant career change where "what I want to do next" is more useful information to an employer than "what I have already done."

items.text: Every word should be replaceable only by something true of you specifically.
"Excellent communication and leadership skills" unsupported by any example is filler recruiters skim past.
